report:
Lymph node, station 7, EBUS-TBNA

Received are two air-dried and two alcohol-fixed smears and a needle rinse (blood-stained), processed as cytospin (1 slide) and cell block (1 block).

The smears (4 slides), cytospin (1 slide) and cell block (1 slide) are adequate for evaluation and show a polymorphous population of small and large lymphoid cells, anthracotic pigment-laden macrophages, bronchial epithelial cells and cartilage (procedural contaminant), cohesive clusters of epithelial cells and atypical cells with prominent nucleoli. Immunostaining on the cell block shows the tumour cells to be positive for TTF-1 and CK7 and negative for p40. Features are those of metastatic adenocarcinoma, consistent with lung primary.

LYMPH NODE, station 7, EBUS-TBNA - METASTATIC ADENOCARCINOMA, CONSISTENT WITH LUNG PRIMARY (Sydney System L5: Malignant)
